duration.text: The Advanced theories and Techniques of Immunology at Jilin University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4583 USD/per year ￥ 33000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Master's degree diploma Postgraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Certificate of HSK Band 6 or above (Not needed for English taught programs 6.Health certificate Not needed during application. But may required when applying for visa. 7.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: Foreign students in good health with related diploma and master degree
